message: Initialized PicAiPic MEX long-term project memory from the current codebase, build manifests, plugin contract documents, and Git history; populated core context and seeded five recurring-task runbooks.

Keep PicAiPic MEX in code-repo mode and maintain AI plugin lifecycle/security as a dedicated context domain because it has independent contracts, runtimes, storage boundaries, and verification workflows.

Completed active-brand migration cleanup: main title bar now shows PicAiPic; updater release-note URL, backup name, map fallback label, VC++ dependency dialog, help menu, AI HTTP user agent, PR artifact names, and Chinese README platform/uninstall instructions now use current PicAiPic identity.

Confirmed cross-library protocol risk: thumb/preview URLs include library id but SQLite lookups use the current-library connection, so delayed requests after switching libraries can resolve duplicate numeric file ids against the wrong database.

Plugin manifest validation enforces pluginApi major but not compatibility.minPicAiPicVersion; package manager/version metadata is also inconsistent because CI uses pnpm while npm lockfiles remain, frontend is 0.2.4, and docs npm lock still names lap-website.

Protocol thumbnail and preview requests now open the database identified by the URL library id, validate that id against configured libraries, and write generated thumbnail cache data back to that same library.
Plugin compatibility now enforces min/max PicAiPic host versions in addition to pluginApi major; JavaScript tooling is standardized on pnpm and package metadata is aligned to 1.0.0.
Home view heavy panels and Content were converted to async components, reducing the Home production chunk from about 527 KB to about 15 KB and removing the Vite chunk-size warning.

Implemented Live Photo + Motion Photo support: Apple Live Photo (HEIC/JPEG+MOV via EXIF ContentIdentifier UUID pairing) and Google Motion Photo (JPEG with embedded MP4 via XMP Container:Directory offset extraction). DB schema migrated to v6 with content_id, paired_file_id, live_photo_type columns. New t_xmp.rs module uses quick-xml for XMP parsing. Long-press preview in MediaViewer with controlless video overlay. Thumbnail LIVE badge and FileInfo type label added.

HEIC container-internal video track extraction is NOT implemented — some Apple Live Photos embed the video in the HEIC container (not as a separate MOV). This requires extending libheif FFI (heif_context_get_list_of_top_level_image_IDs + metadata block API). Currently only HEIC+MOV dual-file mode works.
Update i18n: add 'Live Photo' and 'Motion Photo' labels to src-vite/src/locales/en.json and zh.json for proper localization. Currently the LIVE badge text and type labels are hardcoded in English.

Add automatic cleanup for Motion Photo temp files (currently written to std::env::temp_dir() with blake3 hash naming). Reuse or extend the existing video cache cleanup mechanism to periodically purge stale picaipic_motion_*.mp4 temp files.
P1 Motion Photo cache: extracts now use app_cache_dir/motion_cache with source-keyed reuse, 2GB prune, startup OS-temp purge; clear_video_cache also clears motion_cache.
P2a Live Photo export: t_live_photo still/video/pair, export_live_photo command, LivePhotoExportDialog + file menu; conversion (to_motion/to_pair/keyframe) and HEIC-internal video still future.
Packaged build showing no media likely from missing afiles Live Photo columns after v6 schema change; hardened ensure_live_photo_columns on migrate+open and made query_files tolerate bad rows.
P2b/P2c: export modes to_motion, to_pair, set_keyframe; Motion JPEG packaging in t_xmp; ffmpeg remux/keyframe helpers in t_video; dialog + i18n updated.
rename_file/rename_folder now rollback disk on DB failure; edit_album propagates name errors; get_files_by_sizes reuses suspicious sizes (chunked IN) instead of redundant GROUP BY
P3 HEIC-internal video: t_heif items/sequences FFI, live_photo_type=4 scan, extract to motion_cache, get_paired/export/MediaViewer wired.
MediaViewer: optional-chain props.file?.file_type in floating toolbar class; guard startLivePhotoPlayback when file is null
Confirmed MediaViewer props.file! already fixed; deduped parse_motion_content_id into t_xmp; corrected PairedVideoInfo type docs (1/3/4)
Docs sync 2026-07-17: picaipic-progress, 目前的开发情况, README/zh, live-photo pattern; ready to commit Live Photo + reliability fixes
Live Photo polish: set_keyframe overwrite_original (JPEG only, confirmed+staged), rescan_live_photo_metadata album repair, FileInfo export button, album menu repair entry.
Docs: live-photo user guide + progress/README/ROUTER accuracy (keyframe overwrite done; model dir binding done; one-click private runtime still open).

Implemented confirmed one-click shared→plugin-private runtime switch: host command switch_ai_plugin_profile_to_private_runtime persists synthetic plugin-private binding, clears profile probe cache, marks needsVerify; Settings conflict UI offers Use private runtime after confirmation; shared runtimes untouched; Setup remains user-driven.
Verified shared→private switch path with cargo check/test, cargo fmt, frontend build, and scripts/check_plugin_host.ps1. Docs/ROUTER/plugin-runtime updated for 2026-07-17.

Model UX reinforcement: expose modelFiles in list_ai_plugins; Settings open+validate managed model dir and import selected model files by basename into plugin-data models with containment checks; external binding open+validate.

Sandbox hardening is phased (docs/ai-plugin-sandbox-roadmap.md): Phase 0 enables cross-platform input staging and fail-closed staging errors; OS network/Landlock remain future opt-in spikes, not Settings UI work.
Staging still only rewrites JSON fields named path; plugins using other keys for file refs would bypass staging until the contract is extended.
Sandbox Phase 0 tail: InputStagingReport diagnostics on task message + staging-report.json; unit tests for rewrite/fail-closed/disabled; phase0 verify checklist doc.

Sandbox Phase 1: plugin_writable_roots is the host allow-list for staging skip + optional Windows ACL exclusions (data/cache/outputs/runtimes/code + shared runtimes + bound model dirs + task extras). Adoption stays task-output containment only.
Sandbox Phase 2: stage_one_file prefers same-volume hardlink then copy fallback; InputStagingReport tracks hardlinkedFiles/copiedFiles; fail-closed unchanged.

Docs sync 2026-07-18: sandbox Phase 0–2 marked done across ROUTER/plugin-runtime/progress/目前的开发情况/roadmap/security/current-status; Phase 3 network OS and Phase 4 Landlock explicitly not done; Phase 2 hardlink mainline done but not full zero-copy.

Synced sandbox Phase 0-2 done / Phase 3-4 not-done status across 目前的开发情况, picaipic-progress, roadmap phase board, ROUTER, plugin-runtime, security hardening, current-status, phase0-verify (2026-07-18).

Phase 0 Windows host-path acceptance: 5 input_staging tests + plugin-host green; C: library → D: plugin-cache proves hardlink fail / copy + staging-report.json. Full SA-LUT UI GPU invoke still optional.
SA-LUT full E2E: ROCm start + C:→D: staging (2 copy) + color-transfer produced PNG under plugin-cache task outputs (phase0-e2e-de513e5c).
Split work into live-photo-polish-docs (already on origin) vs plugin-sandbox-phase0-2 (pushed; sandbox 0-2 + private runtime + model UX). package_windows -CheckOnly OK.
User confirmed smoke testing passed for plugin sandbox Phase 0–2 work; checklist GUI/IPC optional item closed.
Planned built-in tools: crop photo-size sub-menu, collage modes, batch wizard — docs/guide/builtin-tools-roadmap.md (A→B→C, not implemented).
MEX scaffold sync 2026-07-18: ROUTER/state for v1.1.0 draft release, release via GitHub assets, built-in tools plan A-B-C; decisions/setup/release-build/patterns refreshed.

Phase A crop presets: string cropPresetId + customCropRatios in configStore; shared photoSizePresets.ts catalog; ImageEditor grouped select + manage/add dialogs; photo presets prefill resize target px.
Phase A shipped 2026-07-18. B collage / C batch still open. Frontend build OK. Roadmap + progress + ROUTER + patterns/change-crop-presets.md updated.
Perf pass after Phase A pack: ImageEditor crop drag rAF + cached rects; customCropRatios avoid re-normalize each tick; edit_image faster resize filter + fused B/C/sat pass.
Phase B1 collage: multi-select SelectionPanel entry, CollageDialog templates 2/4/9, host export_collage save-as only (cover fill, no library mutation).
Collage follow-ups: B2 horizontal/vertical strip + more templates/fill modes; B3 free canvas; optional re-import export into library.
Phase B2 collage: templates 3/6, strip-h/v, fill cover/contain, radius+stroke; export_collage extended with fillMode/radius/stroke; aspect-aware output sizes.
Phase B3 free collage: CollageDialog free canvas with drag/resize/rotate/z/snap; export_collage template free + items[] with center-rotated placement.
Free collage drafts: config.collage.freeDrafts stores named layouts (geometry+style); load remaps by file_path against current selection; max 12 drafts.

Phase C1 batch: BatchProcessDialog 3-step wizard; composable built-in actions (resize/crop/rotate/flip/adjust/filter); action-chain templates; host batch_process_images with progress/cancel; save-as default.
Phase C2 batch actions: border, expand, image watermark, text (ab_glyph + system fonts); palette/UI/host apply_batch_* helpers.
Print layout 冲印排版: paper packing UI with built-in/custom papers+layouts, auto grid/mixed pack math, export_print_layout host sheet render; entry from multi-select.
Print layout A–D: mixed H/V-band packing + auto utilization; custom paper form; OS print_file/temp_file_path; optional import sheet into current album via import_file.
print_file uses Windows Print verb / CUPS lp with open fallback; does not block on job completion. Magazine-style freeform packing still future.
Removed host system-print for print layout; keep single-image window.print. Fixed PrintLayoutDialog freeze by not mutating pinia config inside computed getters.

Print layout: fill-the-paper packing (NeoImaging-like) + A4 presets; print via temp export + window.print. Collage: magazine freeform cells from NeoImaging PatternJigsaw configs; host export_collage supports cells payload.

Docs/MEX GROW: print layout fill packing + A4 + window.print + temp cache cleanup + cell-sized source decode; collage magazine cells + cell-sized decode on grid/cells/free. Patterns/ROUTER/roadmap/progress updated 2026-07-19.
Print DPI is export/sheet density only (not OS printer DPI). Temp delete is scoped to system temp + print_layout_/picaipic_ prefixes.
GROW complete: ROUTER last_updated 2026-07-19; patterns change-print-layout + change-collage rewritten; INDEX/roadmap D + B magazine notes; progress zh/en appended.
Print layout: export stays full plan DPI; print uses print-sized canvas (~1800px long edge) + blob URL + window.print so system dialog opens fast. Docs/MEX patterns updated.
Print cache uses shallow fingerprint (fileAssignmentKey); deep watch thrash fixed. Temp/blob cleanup on layout change and dialog close.
GROW: roadmap D + ROUTER + change-print-layout + progress zh/en updated for print-sized (~1800) vs full-DPI export split.

Replaced window.prompt/confirm in CollageDialog + BatchProcessDialog with MessageBox + plugin-dialog ask (fixes Tauri WebView no-op; prevents silent overwrite). Free collage source headroom now uses true rotated AABB instead of fixed 1.15×.
Batch overwrite previously could skip confirmation when window.confirm returned undefined in Tauri WebView — fixed via ask().
batch_process_images: serial dest reservation + bounded JoinSet workers (2–8); GridView VirtualScroll buffer 4→8. SearchBox is Enter-submit (no input debounce needed).
Face recognition index P0 still open: parallel worker pool + batched DB writes + optional DirectML/CoreML GPU — separate schedule.
Face index CPU P0: multi-engine worker pool (2–4) + Face::apply_scan_batch_with_conn (~32). No shared Session; GPU EP deferred.
Optional face index GPU: DirectML/CoreML ort EP probe per platform after CPU path is stable.
Phase 1 Lap-port: search_similar_images uses blob cosine + get_files_by_ids(chunk 500); Content clamps fetch chunks and defers semantic thumbs to viewport.
Phase 2: ImageViewer splitCount 1/2/4 with bottomLeft/bottomRight panes, cycle-split toolbar, Content pane passthrough + placeholder hydrate.
Phase 3 Collections: schema v7 acollections*, ACollection CRUD/query IPC, CollectionTray, Content collection source + drag-drop add.
Phase 4 Smart Albums: server-side SmartQueryParams SQL, LibraryState smartAlbums, SmartAlbumList/Edit, Content smart query source.
Phase 5 library polish: Library panel All/Favorites/Today quick entries + Content view-adaptive dateGrouping prop to GridView (incremental, keep AlbumList).
Fixed confirmed lap bugs: schema v8 UNIQUE(folder_id,name)+ON CONFLICT+AlbumScanGuard; Content removeFilesByIds+timeline refresh; move_file recount/pair_live_photos; thumbnail null guards.

Second-wave lap fixes: #204 metadata (libraw spacing, little_exif JPEG capture, partial EXIF), #186 probe bounds + FileInfo zoom, #199 folder restore flicker, multi-select external open with mixed/100 safeguards.
Third wave: multi-select shared context menu + SelectionPanel external open; Video.vue mpg/mpeg/vob fail-fast with external-player guidance.
Fourth wave: Video compatibility UX (overlay, direct→compatible→process, MKV bypass, 30s deadline, cancel on external); multi-select shared menu plugin actions on focused image.
AI PNG prompt import (v1): scan fills empty comments from A1111/NovelAI/InvokeAI/ComfyUI PNG text; default on; no full-library backfill; JPEG deferred.
Extended AI prompt import to JPEG UserComment/COM (+ ImageDescription heuristic fallback); still empty-comments only, default on.
Shipped configurable thumbnail media badges (format/ISO/shutter/aperture/focal/exposure), default off, max 4 overlays.
Shipped viewer background modes (theme/black/white/gray/checker), Settings select, toolbar palette, shortcut B.
AI/similar search honors Image/RAW/Video filter via search_file_type; search results show Visual/Similar/Filename section headers.

Docs/MEX refresh 2026-07-20: recorded Lap 0.3 UX pack (prompt import PNG+JPEG, media badges, viewer bg, AI search filters) in picaipic-progress, 目前的开发情况, ROUTER, decisions/stack/architecture/conventions, patterns INDEX.
G1 cancelled (no collage-in-batch). Shipped G2 batch importToLibrary MVP; G6 multi-key trust + local revoke foundation; G3–G5 scaffold flags/start.log only (no OS enforcement).

G2: BatchProcessResult.outputPaths + Content.onBatchDone saveAs importFile / overwrite updateFileInfo. G6: trust_publisher adds keys; revoke_publisher_key fail-closed. Sandbox flags: NETWORK_SANDBOX, LINUX_LANDLOCK, ENV_HYGIENE.
G5 env hygiene: opt-in PICAIPIC_ENABLE_PLUGIN_ENV_HYGIENE clears ambient env and re-injects allowlist (PATH/GPU/PICAIPIC_*) before host plugin vars on start/setup; default remains inherit.

G3 network sandbox spike: opt-in flag + no runtime_network grant attempts Windows netsh outbound block on plugin start program; soft-fail to policy_only; always injects PICAIPIC_PLUGIN_NETWORK_POLICY; default off.
G4 Landlock spike: opt-in PICAIPIC_ENABLE_LINUX_LANDLOCK applies FS ruleset (RW plugin_writable_roots, RO system+plugin root) via pre_exec restrict_self; soft-fail if ABI missing; default off.
